results.title: Yango, Rosatom, Nordgold: The Russian firms thriving in Africa despite sanctions
results.snippet:
In Arlit, uranium is no longer French, but nor is it Russian. After nationalising Somaïr, a subsidiary of Orano, then reallocating its permits to state-owned companies in August, Niamey has made a series of overtures to Moscow — notably through a memorandum between its company Timersoi and Rosatom subsidiary Uranium One.
